praises: Newest Arrow Lake-HX refresh CPU (290HX Plus) — top-tier multicore for a mid-GPU chassis

Turbo mode fan noise under load
Plastic chassis flex vs aluminum rivals at this price

design_philosophy: The 2026 refresh top trim of the mainstream Strix G16: newest Intel HX silicon and a 300Hz competitive panel paired with the same full-TGP RTX 5070 — a CPU/refresh play rather than a GPU step-up.
